# GravelScope

> GravelScope provides free browser-based planning tools and practical guides for estimating gravel quantities, weight, bags and material cost.

## Main Tool
- https://gravelscope.website/ — Gravel Calculator for cubic yards, cubic feet, tons, kilograms, bags and estimated material cost.

## Planning Guides
- https://gravelscope.website/guides/ — Gravel planning guide hub.
- https://gravelscope.website/guides/gravel-depth/ — How deep gravel should be for common project types.
- https://gravelscope.website/guides/gravel-density-tons-cubic-yards/ — Gravel density, tons and cubic yards explained.
- https://gravelscope.website/guides/extra-gravel-allowance/ — Choosing an extra gravel allowance.
- https://gravelscope.website/guides/gravel-cost/ — Estimating gravel project cost.
- https://gravelscope.website/guides/gravel-types/ — Types of gravel, sizes and sub-base grades.
- https://gravelscope.website/guides/10x10-gravel-calculator/ — Gravel needed for a 10x10 area.
- https://gravelscope.website/guides/10x12-gravel-calculator/ — Gravel needed for a 10x12 area.
- https://gravelscope.website/guides/pea-gravel-calculator/ — Pea gravel quantities in yards, tons and bags.
- https://gravelscope.website/guides/driveway-gravel-calculator/ — Driveway gravel calculator for sub-base and surface layers.
